# mnightingale.dev

> Personal portfolio of Marcus Nightingale, senior PHP developer in Stockport, UK.
> 10+ years building high-throughput web platforms (PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Redis, Elasticsearch).
> ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Lead Implementer. Indie game developer (Nightingale Games).
> Currently open to opportunities.

## About

Marcus Nightingale is a senior PHP developer based in Stockport, Greater Manchester, UK.
Most recently Core Lead Developer & ISMS Lead at Symphony Commerce (2020-2026),
with technical ownership of a core ecommerce platform. He designed and built an
ISO 27001 audit platform (UDP ingestion, Laravel APIs, ClickHouse) production-tested
at ~60,000 requests per second, and led ISO 27001:2022 certification with zero
major or minor non-conformities.

## Projects

- [Asteroid Mining Empire](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4516220/Asteroid_Mining_Empire/): fast-paced pixel-art space mining game on Steam (Windows, macOS, Linux). Released April 2026 by Nightingale Games.
- [ISO 27001 SoA Generator](https://mnightingale.dev/ISO27001-2022-SOA-Generator/): single-file client-side Statement of Applicability builder with XLSX/JSON export. Guided wizard over the 93 Annex A controls (A.5–A.8): applicability, implementation status, justifications, documented information, owners, plus custom controls. State stays in localStorage.
- [ISO 27001 Control Bento](https://mnightingale.dev/ISO27001-2022-Control-Bento/): the 93 Annex A controls as an interactive bento grid. Search by ID/title/description, filter by type, deep-linkable control detail with implementation guidance and evidence examples. Covers Annex A only; clauses 4–10 are out of scope.
- [EUR Exchange Rates](https://octopus-exchange-bvj4q.ondigitalocean.app): live Euro rates for 165 currencies with converter and charts.
- [CodePen sketches](https://codepen.io/marcus-nightingale): front-end experiments.
